blocks.zh: 1.1 §211.22 — Quality Control Unit (QCU): The Independence Requirement 1.1 §211.22 — 品質控制單位（QCU）：獨立性要求
blocks.en: 1.1 §211.22 — Quality Control Unit (QCU): The Independence Requirement

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QCU 獨立性為何如此重要？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is QCU Independence So Important?

blocks.zh: §211.22 是整個 21 CFR Part 211 中最常被 FDA 觀察員在 483 表中引用的條款。核心問題不是「有沒有 QA 部門」，而是「QA 部門能否在不受生產壓力影響的情況下行使否決權（reject authority）」。
blocks.en: §211.22 is the provision of 21 CFR Part 211 most often cited by FDA investigators on Form 483. The core question is not "do you have a QA department," but "can the QA department exercise its reject authority without being influenced by production pressure."

blocks.zh: 獨立性的三個測試：
blocks.en: Three tests of independence:

blocks.zh: 組織架構獨立： QCU 負責人（QA Director / VP of Quality）不應向生產副總裁匯報，而應直接向公司最高管理層匯報。
blocks.en: Organizational independence: The head of the QCU (QA Director / VP of Quality) should not report to the VP of Production, but directly to the company's top management.

blocks.zh: 決策獨立： QCU 可以在不獲得生產部門同意的情況下拒絕放行批次。
blocks.en: Decision independence: The QCU can reject a batch without the agreement of the production department.

blocks.zh: 資源獨立： QCU 必須有足夠的實驗室設施（§211.22(b)），不能依賴生產部門才能執行測試。
blocks.en: Resource independence: The QCU must have adequate laboratory facilities (§211.22(b)) and must not depend on production in order to carry out testing.

blocks.zh: 最常見 483 觀察項目 — QCU 相關
blocks.en: Most Common 483 Observations: QCU-Related

blocks.zh: FDA 483 高頻缺失模式：
blocks.en: Frequent FDA 483 deficiency patterns:

blocks.zh: QCU 未能充分調查超標（OOS）結果即放行批次
blocks.en: The QCU released a batch without adequately investigating an out-of-specification (OOS) result

blocks.zh: 生產記錄中的錯誤未被 QCU 完全調查（§211.22(a) 後半段）
blocks.en: Errors in production records were not fully investigated by the QCU (second half of §211.22(a))

blocks.zh: QCU 書面程序不存在或未被遵循（§211.22(d)）
blocks.en: QCU written procedures do not exist or are not followed (§211.22(d))

blocks.zh: QCU 未審查影響產品品質的新程序或規格變更（§211.22(c)）
blocks.en: The QCU did not review new procedures or specification changes that affect product quality (§211.22(c))

blocks.zh: 合約製造商的產品被合約委託方（原廠）的 QCU 以外的人員放行
blocks.en: Product from a contract manufacturer was released by someone other than the QCU of the contract giver (the originator)

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：合約製造的 QCU 責任歸屬
blocks.en: CDMO Context: Allocation of QCU Responsibility in Contract Manufacturing

blocks.zh: §211.22(a) 的最後一句話在 CDMO 業務中極為重要：「受合約委託製造的藥品，QCU 的放行責任在受託方（CDMO）。」
blocks.en: The last sentence of §211.22(a) is extremely important in CDMO business: "For drugs manufactured under contract, release responsibility of the QCU rests with the contract acceptor (the CDMO)."

blocks.zh: 常見誤解：客戶（委託方）說「我們自己有 QA 會審查」→ 這不免除 CDMO 的 QCU 放行責任。兩家公司都必須有 QCU 行使職責：CDMO 的 QCU 放行「製造批次」，客戶的 QCU 放行「最終商業化產品」。
blocks.en: Common misunderstanding: the client (contract giver) says, "We have our own QA that will review," and this does not relieve the CDMO's QCU of its release responsibility. Both companies must have a QCU exercising its duties: the CDMO's QCU releases the "manufactured batch," and the client's QCU releases the "final commercial product."

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement（品質協議） 必須清楚界定哪些 QCU 活動由誰執行。FDA 查廠時會要求查閱這份協議。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement must clearly define which QCU activities are performed by whom. FDA will ask to see this agreement during an inspection.

blocks.zh: 小型公司 / 新創藥廠的 QCU 設計挑戰
blocks.en: QCU Design Challenges for Small Companies / Start-Up Drug Makers

blocks.zh: §211.22 允許「任何人或組織單元（any person or organizational element）」擔任 QCU——包括外包或單人 QCU。這對資源有限的小型製藥公司或新創 CDMO 至關重要：
blocks.en: §211.22 allows "any person or organizational element" to serve as the QCU, including an outsourced or one-person QCU. This is critical for small pharmaceutical companies or start-up CDMOs with limited resources:

blocks.zh: 外包 QCU（Contract QA Services）： 雖然合法，但 §211.22(a) 的「責任和權力」必須實際在外包合約中被授予——書面合約必須賦予外包 QCU 否決生產決策的真實權力，而非僅為「審查和建議」的顧問角色。外包但無否決權的 QA 服務不滿足 §211.22。
blocks.en: Outsourced QCU (Contract QA Services): This is legal, but the "responsibility and authority" in §211.22(a) must actually be granted in the outsourcing contract. The written contract must give the outsourced QCU real authority to veto production decisions, not merely an advisory role of "review and recommend." Outsourced QA services without veto authority do not satisfy §211.22.

blocks.zh: 單人 QCU： 一人可以合法地擔任整個 QCU，前提是這個人具備足夠資格（§211.25）並且在組織上獨立於生產。在極小型設施中，老闆同時擔任 QCU 負責人在技術上可能合規，但 FDA 會非常仔細地審查這種安排的實際獨立性。
blocks.en: One-person QCU: One person can legally serve as the entire QCU, provided that the person is adequately qualified (§211.25) and organizationally independent of production. In a very small facility, having the owner also act as head of the QCU may technically comply, but FDA will scrutinize the actual independence of such an arrangement very closely.

blocks.zh: 矩陣式 QCU： 一些公司讓多個部門人員共同承擔 QCU 職責（如生產主任負責在製品放行、QA 專員負責最終批次放行）。這種安排必須在書面程序中明確定義每個人的 QCU 職責邊界，並確保關鍵放行決策由具備足夠獨立性的人員做出。
blocks.en: Matrix QCU: Some companies have staff from several departments share QCU duties (for example, the production supervisor releases in-process material and a QA specialist performs final batch release). Such an arrangement must define each person's QCU responsibility boundaries in a written procedure and ensure that critical release decisions are made by people with adequate independence.

blocks.zh: FDA 的關鍵問題： 「你的 QCU 是否真的有能力（technically capable）和權力（actually authorized）拒絕放行批次，即使這意味著公司在財務上蒙受損失？」這個問題的答案，不在組織架構圖上，而在實際的歷史案例記錄中。
blocks.en: The key FDA question: "Is your QCU truly technically capable of, and actually authorized to, reject a batch, even if that means the company suffers a financial loss?" The answer to this question is found not on the organization chart but in the record of actual historical cases.

blocks.zh: QCU 職權範圍一覽 — §211.22(a)(c) 對照
blocks.en: QCU Scope of Authority at a Glance: §211.22(a)-(c) Cross-Reference

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: QCU 的角色就像建築工程的「監工結構工程師」：生產部門（承包商）負責施工，但每個關鍵里程碑（地基、結構、竣工）都必須由獨立的結構工程師簽字才能繼續。如果承包商可以自己簽自己的工程驗收，整個安全體系就崩潰了。
blocks.en: The role of the QCU is like that of the "supervising structural engineer" on a construction project: production (the contractor) does the building, but every critical milestone (foundation, structure, completion) must be signed off by an independent structural engineer before work can continue. If the contractor could sign off its own work, the whole safety system would collapse.

blocks.zh: §211.22(a) 的邏輯完全相同：生產部門不能自行核准自己製造的批次——必須有組織上獨立的 QCU 審查並核准，才能進入市場。
blocks.en: The logic of §211.22(a) is exactly the same: the production department cannot approve batches it made itself. An organizationally independent QCU must review and approve them before they can reach the market.

blocks.zh: 「Right-First-Time」文化 vs 檢驗驅動合規
blocks.en: "Right-First-Time" Culture vs. Inspection-Driven Compliance

blocks.zh: §211.22 的設計哲學隱含一個重要的文化問題：很多公司將 QCU 的存在視為「最後防線」——生產可以犯錯，只要 QCU 在最後抓到就好。這種「檢驗驅動合規（inspection-driven compliance）」模式是 FDA 批評的低成熟度品質文化。
blocks.en: The design philosophy of §211.22 implies an important cultural question: many companies see the QCU as the "last line of defense," on the idea that production may make mistakes as long as the QCU catches them at the end. This "inspection-driven compliance" model is the low-maturity quality culture that FDA criticizes.

blocks.zh: FDA 2011 年「Process Validation Guidance」和更廣泛的品質系統指引明確指出，品質應「內建於製程（built into the process）」，而非僅靠終端檢驗保障。§211.22 賦予 QCU 廣泛職權的目的，是讓 QCU 能夠主動介入和預防問題，而非只是被動放行或拒絕。
blocks.en: FDA's 2011 Process Validation Guidance and broader quality systems guidance state clearly that quality should be "built into the process" rather than assured only by end-product testing. The purpose of the broad authority §211.22 gives the QCU is to let it intervene proactively and prevent problems, not merely to release or reject passively.

blocks.zh: 「Right-First-Time」文化的 QCU 表徵：
blocks.en: Signs of a QCU in a "Right-First-Time" culture:

blocks.zh: QCU 主導根本原因分析（RCA）和 CAPA，而非僅審查批次記錄
blocks.en: The QCU leads root cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA, rather than merely reviewing batch records

blocks.zh: QCU 參與新產品或新製程的設計審查（Design Review），在問題出現前提供品質輸入
blocks.en: The QCU takes part in design reviews of new products or processes and provides quality input before problems appear

blocks.zh: QCU 定期向最高管理層匯報品質指標（Quality Metrics），包括 OOS 率、偏差率、CAPA 完成率
blocks.en: The QCU regularly reports quality metrics to top management, including OOS rate, deviation rate and CAPA completion rate

blocks.zh: 偏差率和再加工率低且穩定（而非「偏差很多但都被 QCU 調查關閉」）
blocks.en: Deviation and reprocessing rates are low and stable (rather than "many deviations, all investigated and closed by the QCU")

blocks.zh: FDA 的 Warning Letter 最嚴厲的語言，通常針對那些「有大量偏差和調查，但所有調查都被快速關閉、沒有有效 CAPA」的設施——這正是「合規但不健康」的品質文化的特徵。
blocks.en: The harshest language in FDA Warning Letters is usually aimed at facilities with "a large number of deviations and investigations, all closed quickly without effective CAPA," which is the hallmark of a "compliant but unhealthy" quality culture.

blocks.zh: §211.22 QCU 職責的跨章節延伸
blocks.en: Cross-Section Extensions of the §211.22 QCU Responsibilities

blocks.zh: §211.22 與 §211.42 的組織連結（建築與人員流動）
blocks.en: Organizational Links Between §211.22 and §211.42 (Buildings and Personnel Flow)

blocks.zh: 雖然 §211.42（廠房設施要求）的完整內容涵蓋於本文件的 Section 2，但 QCU 的職責與設施設計密切相關：
blocks.en: Although the full content of §211.42 (facility requirements) is covered in Section 2 of this document, QCU responsibilities are closely tied to facility design:

blocks.zh: 潔淨區分級（Cleanroom Classification）、人員流動路線（Personnel Flow）和設備隔離（Segregation）設計，都必須在 §211.22(c) 下由 QCU 核准的書面程序中定義
blocks.en: Cleanroom classification, personnel flow and equipment segregation design must all be defined in written procedures approved by the QCU under §211.22(c)

blocks.zh: QCU 對生產區域的存取權（§211.22(a) — QCU 有權查閱生產記錄）意味著 QCU 人員必須能夠進入相關生產區域進行現場稽核
blocks.en: The QCU's right of access to production areas (§211.22(a): the QCU may review production records) means QCU staff must be able to enter the relevant production areas to conduct on-site audits

blocks.zh: 無菌設施的設施驗證（IQ/OQ/PQ）報告需由 QCU 核准，確保設施設計符合品質要求
blocks.en: Qualification reports (IQ/OQ/PQ) for sterile facilities must be approved by the QCU to ensure the facility design meets quality requirements

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 的 QA 主管向生產副總裁匯報。FDA 查廠時這會如何被解讀？
blocks.en: The head of QA at a CDMO reports to the VP of Production. How would FDA interpret this during an inspection?

blocks.zh: 客戶要求 CDMO 「先放行批次、文件補充後再審」，CDMO 的 QCU 應如何回應？引用哪個法規？
blocks.en: A client asks the CDMO to "release the batch first and complete the documentation later." How should the CDMO's QCU respond, and which regulation should it cite?

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 QCU 在沒有實驗室的情況下（全部外包給合約實驗室）可以合規嗎？需要什麼前提條件？
blocks.en: Can a CDMO's QCU comply without a laboratory of its own (all testing outsourced to contract laboratories)? What preconditions are needed?

blocks.zh: 1.2 §211.25 — Personnel Qualifications 1.2 §211.25 — 人員資格
blocks.en: 1.2 §211.25 — Personnel Qualifications

blocks.zh: 「合格（Qualified）」vs「受訓（Trained）」的法規區別
blocks.en: Regulatory Difference Between "Qualified" and "Trained"

blocks.zh: 這是 §211.25 最常被誤解的地方。法規要求的是教育 + 訓練 + 經驗的組合，而非單純「完成訓練課程」。
blocks.en: This is the most commonly misunderstood point of §211.25. The regulation requires a combination of education, training and experience, not merely "completing a training course."

blocks.zh: 受訓（Trained）： 員工閱讀了 SOP 並簽名確認。這只是合規的最低門檻。
blocks.en: Trained: The employee has read the SOP and signed to confirm it. This is only the minimum threshold for compliance.

blocks.zh: 合格（Qualified）： 員工具備足夠的教育背景、訓練課時、和實際操作經驗，能夠獨立勝任該職位的 GMP 職能。資格應通過能力評估（competency assessment）確認，而非僅憑訓練簽名。
blocks.en: Qualified: The employee has adequate education, training hours and hands-on experience to perform the GMP functions of the position independently. Qualification should be confirmed through a competency assessment, not just a training signature.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時可能要求看：(1) 職位說明書（Job Description）中的資格要求；(2) 員工的教育背景文件；(3) 訓練記錄；(4) 能力評估結果。
blocks.en: During an inspection, FDA may ask to see: (1) the qualification requirements in the job description; (2) documentation of the employee's educational background; (3) training records; (4) competency assessment results.

blocks.zh: §211.25 在 FDA 執法中的系統性意義
blocks.en: Systemic Significance of §211.25 in FDA Enforcement

blocks.zh: 雖然 §211.25 本身不是高頻 Warning Letter 引用條款（相比 §211.22 或 §211.192），但人員資格不足往往是嚴重 CGMP 失敗的根本原因（Root Cause），而非直接被引用的條款。FDA Warning Letter 的邏輯通常是：
blocks.en: Although §211.25 itself is not a frequently cited Warning Letter provision (compared with §211.22 or §211.192), inadequate personnel qualification is often the root cause of serious CGMP failures rather than the provision that is directly cited. The logic of an FDA Warning Letter usually runs as follows:

blocks.zh: 「你的設施出現了大量 OOS 結果和偏差 → 調查發現原因是操作員錯誤 → 追溯顯示操作員的訓練記錄缺失或不完整 → 根本原因：§211.25 的訓練和資格要求未得到滿足 → §211.22 的 QCU 監督也因而失效」
blocks.en: "Your facility had many OOS results and deviations → the investigation found the cause was operator error → tracing back showed the operator's training records were missing or incomplete → root cause: the training and qualification requirements of §211.25 were not met → QCU oversight under §211.22 therefore also failed."

blocks.zh: 這種「連鎖違規」模式在 Warning Letter 中非常常見。一個看似孤立的操作失誤，如果根本原因追蹤到系統性的訓練缺失，往往導致 QCU 獨立性（§211.22）和 CAPA 有效性（§211.192 書面調查）被一起引用。
blocks.en: This "chain of violations" pattern is very common in Warning Letters. An apparently isolated operating error, if its root cause traces back to a systemic training gap, often leads to the QCU independence provision (§211.22) and CAPA effectiveness (§211.192, written investigations) being cited together.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示： 當發生生產偏差時，首先要問的不只是「這次操作出了什麼問題」，而是「是否有足夠的訓練和資格體系支撐這個操作，以防止同類問題重複發生」。這個問題的答案決定了 CAPA 是「即時糾正」還是「系統性改善」。
blocks.en: Lesson for CDMOs: When a production deviation occurs, the first question is not only "what went wrong in this operation," but "is there a training and qualification system adequate to support this operation and prevent the same problem from recurring." The answer determines whether the CAPA is an "immediate correction" or a "systemic improvement."

blocks.zh: 訓練矩陣（Training Matrix）設計原則
blocks.en: Training Matrix Design Principles

blocks.zh: 符合 §211.25 的訓練計劃應包含以下要素：
blocks.en: A training program that complies with §211.25 should include the following elements:

blocks.zh: 初始訓練（Initial Training）： 新進人員入職時完成，涵蓋 CGMP 基礎 + 崗位專屬 SOP
blocks.en: Initial Training: Completed when new staff join, covering CGMP basics plus position-specific SOPs

blocks.zh: 持續訓練（Continuing Training）： 定期（通常每年）複訓，法規要求「足夠頻率」
blocks.en: Continuing Training: Periodic refresher training (usually annual); the regulation requires "sufficient frequency"

blocks.zh: 更新訓練（Change-Driven Training）： SOP 修訂、設備更換、新法規發布後觸發
blocks.en: Change-Driven Training: Triggered by SOP revisions, equipment changes and the issuance of new regulations

blocks.zh: 矯正訓練（Corrective Training）： CAPA 或調查發現訓練缺失時觸發
blocks.en: Corrective Training: Triggered when a CAPA or investigation finds a training gap

blocks.zh: 訓練人員資格（§211.25(a) 最後一句）： 必須由「合格個人（qualified individuals）」執行訓練。訓練者本身也需要有訓練者資格文件。
blocks.en: Trainer qualification (last sentence of §211.25(a)): Training must be given by "qualified individuals." Trainers themselves also need documented trainer qualification.

blocks.zh: 訓練記錄要素比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Training Record Elements

blocks.zh: §211.25 的「合格」標準就像飛行員執照制度：一名飛行員必須通過學科考試（教育）、飛行小時要求（經驗）、和模擬機評估（能力測試）才能取得執照。光是「閱讀了飛行手冊並簽名」是完全不夠的。
blocks.en: The "qualified" standard of §211.25 is like the pilot licensing system: a pilot must pass written exams (education), meet flight-hour requirements (experience) and pass simulator assessments (competency testing) to obtain a license. Merely "reading the flight manual and signing" is nowhere near enough.

blocks.zh: 藥廠操作員的資格認定邏輯相同。一名無菌灌裝操作員必須有：(1) 足夠的生命科學背景教育；(2) 完整的相關 SOP 訓練記錄；(3) 實際操作的 OJT 評估；以及 (4) 能力評估（通常包括模擬灌裝或媒液灌裝觀察）——才能被視為「合格的無菌灌裝操作員」。
blocks.en: The same logic applies to qualifying pharmaceutical operators. An aseptic filling operator must have: (1) adequate education in the life sciences; (2) complete training records on the relevant SOPs; (3) an on-the-job training (OJT) assessment of actual operations; and (4) a competency assessment (usually including observed simulated filling or media fill) before being considered a "qualified aseptic filling operator."

blocks.zh: §211.25(b) 主管資格的額外要求： 主管不僅需要自身合格，還必須「以確保藥品具備其聲稱品質和純度的方式」行使職能。這意味著主管必須理解其監督活動如何影響產品品質——不只是操作執行，還包括對品質系統的理解和判斷能力。
blocks.en: Additional requirements for supervisors under §211.25(b): Supervisors must not only be qualified themselves but must also perform their functions "in such a manner as to provide assurance that the drug product has the safety, identity, strength, quality, and purity that it purports or is represented to possess." This means supervisors must understand how their supervisory activities affect product quality, including an understanding of the quality system and the judgment to apply it, not just the execution of operations.

blocks.zh: §211.25 人員訓練相關高頻 483 觀察
blocks.en: Frequent 483 Observations on Personnel Training Under §211.25

blocks.zh: FDA 就訓練記錄最常見的 483 觀察項目：
blocks.en: The most common 483 observations on training records:

blocks.zh: 訓練記錄不完整： 員工執行操作時所用 SOP 版本不在其訓練記錄中（例：SOP 已更新為 Rev. 3，員工只有 Rev. 1 的訓練記錄）
blocks.en: Incomplete training records: The SOP version the employee used for an operation is not in the training record (for example, the SOP has been updated to Rev. 3 but the employee has training records only for Rev. 1)

blocks.zh: 沒有 CGMP 年度訓練： 訓練系統只有入職訓練，缺乏法規要求的持續訓練計劃
blocks.en: No annual CGMP training: The training system has only onboarding training and lacks the continuing training program the regulation requires

blocks.zh: 訓練者沒有資格文件： 負責培訓其他員工的訓練師自身沒有訓練者資格記錄
blocks.en: Trainers without qualification documents: The trainers responsible for training other employees have no trainer qualification records of their own

blocks.zh: 訓練有效性未確認： 員工「讀了」SOP 但公司無法證明員工「理解了」SOP（缺乏能力評估）
blocks.en: Training effectiveness not confirmed: Employees "read" the SOP but the company cannot demonstrate that they "understood" it (no competency assessment)

blocks.zh: CAPA 後訓練缺失： 調查報告的 CAPA 行動中提到「再訓練」，但訓練系統中找不到對應的訓練記錄
blocks.en: Missing training after CAPA: The CAPA actions in an investigation report mention "retraining," but no corresponding training record can be found in the training system

blocks.zh: 人員不足（§211.25(c)）： 批次記錄顯示同一 QA 人員在同一天內審查了不切實際數量的批次，暗示資源嚴重不足
blocks.en: Insufficient personnel (§211.25(c)): Batch records show the same QA reviewer reviewed an unrealistic number of batches in one day, suggesting a serious shortage of resources

blocks.zh: 一名有 10 年藥廠生產經驗但沒有大學學歷的操作員，是否可以被認定為「合格」的無菌灌裝人員？請引用 §211.25(a) 的文字說明。
blocks.en: An operator has 10 years of pharmaceutical manufacturing experience but no university degree. Can this operator be considered a "qualified" aseptic filling operator? Cite the text of §211.25(a) in your answer.

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員問：「你如何確保員工仍然熟悉適用的 CGMP 要求？」你的答案應包含哪些文件證據？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator asks: "How do you ensure employees remain familiar with the applicable CGMP requirements?" What documentary evidence should your answer include?

blocks.zh: 一家快速成長的 CDMO 在六個月內員工數量從 50 人增加到 150 人，但訓練部門只有一名訓練專員。這在 §211.25(c) 下構成合規風險嗎？應如何論證？
blocks.en: A fast-growing CDMO goes from 50 to 150 employees in six months, but the training department has only one training specialist. Does this create a compliance risk under §211.25(c)? How would you argue the point?

blocks.zh: 1.3 §211.28 — Personnel Responsibilities: Health, Apparel & Hygiene 1.3 §211.28 — 人員職責：健康、服裝與衛生
blocks.en: 1.3 §211.28 — Personnel Responsibilities: Health, Apparel & Hygiene

blocks.zh: §211.28 是 CGMP「地板」，不是「天花板」
blocks.en: §211.28 Is the CGMP "Floor," Not the "Ceiling"

blocks.zh: §211.28 設定的是適用於所有藥品製造的基準最低要求（baseline floor）。對於非無菌製造（如固體口服製劑），嚴格遵守 §211.28 通常已足夠。
blocks.en: §211.28 sets the baseline minimum requirements (baseline floor) that apply to all drug manufacturing. For non-sterile manufacturing (such as oral solid dosage forms), strict compliance with §211.28 is usually sufficient.

blocks.zh: 但對於無菌製造，§211.28 只是起點。更高要求來自：
blocks.en: For sterile manufacturing, however, §211.28 is only the starting point. Higher expectations come from:

blocks.zh: FDA 無菌指引（2004/2022 draft）： 無菌灌裝人員的著裝資格確認（Gowning Qualification）、無菌技術評估、環境監控失敗的人員調查
blocks.en: FDA aseptic processing guidance (2004 / 2022 draft): Gowning qualification of aseptic filling personnel, assessment of aseptic technique, and personnel investigations of environmental monitoring failures

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（2022）： 詳細規範潔淨區各等級（A/B/C/D）的著裝要求、著裝程序、手部消毒頻率、每人每次進入的菌落計數監控
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): Detailed gowning requirements for each cleanroom grade (A/B/C/D), gowning procedures, hand disinfection frequency, and colony count monitoring for each person on each entry

blocks.zh: PIC/S： 對應 Annex 1 的要求
blocks.en: PIC/S: Requirements corresponding to Annex 1

blocks.zh: 在查廠情境中，FDA 查廠官員可能因設施類型不同而引用不同層次的要求。理解這個「層次結構」有助於正確回應觀察發現。
blocks.en: In an inspection, FDA investigators may cite different levels of requirements depending on the facility type. Understanding this "hierarchy" helps in responding correctly to observations.

blocks.zh: §211.28 在 FDA 執法案例中的角色
blocks.en: Role of §211.28 in FDA Enforcement Cases

blocks.zh: §211.28 單獨被引用作為主要 483 觀察的情況相對少見；它更常作為一組系統性缺失的一部分出現。以下是幾類典型的執法模式：
blocks.en: §211.28 is relatively rarely cited alone as the main 483 observation; it more often appears as part of a group of systemic deficiencies. Typical enforcement patterns include:

blocks.zh: 模式 1 — 著裝程序書面化不足： 設施有著裝要求但沒有書面 SOP，或 SOP 存在但實際操作與程序不符。FDA 會同時引用 §211.28(b)（缺乏適當著裝）和 §211.22(d)（程序未被遵循）。
blocks.en: Pattern 1: Inadequately documented gowning procedures. The facility has gowning requirements but no written SOP, or an SOP exists but actual practice does not match it. FDA will cite both §211.28(b) (lack of appropriate protective apparel) and §211.22(d) (procedures not followed).

blocks.zh: 模式 2 — 人員健康申報系統缺失： §211.28(a) 要求「所有人員」被指示向主管報告可能影響品質的健康狀況。如果設施沒有書面的健康申報程序（何種症狀需申報、如何申報、誰接受申報、如何處置），就缺乏實現 §211.28(a) 後半段要求的系統。
blocks.en: Pattern 2: No system for reporting personnel health conditions. §211.28(a) requires that "all personnel" be instructed to report to supervisors any health conditions that may adversely affect drug products. If the facility has no written health reporting procedure (which symptoms must be reported, how to report, who receives the report, how it is handled), it lacks the system needed to meet the second half of §211.28(a).

blocks.zh: 模式 3 — 無菌核心區著裝觀察不一致： FDA 查廠官員在現場觀察到不合著裝要求的行為（如未覆蓋頭髮的碎發、手套破損繼續操作），即使有書面程序也會引用 §211.28(b) — 因為法規要求的是實際執行，而非文件存在。
blocks.en: Pattern 3: Inconsistent gowning observed in the aseptic core. When FDA investigators observe behavior on site that does not meet gowning requirements (such as uncovered stray hair or continuing to work with a damaged glove), they will cite §211.28(b) even if a written procedure exists, because the regulation requires actual practice, not just the existence of documents.

blocks.zh: 模式 4 — 無授權人員進入限制區域： §211.28(d) 的進入授權要求，若缺乏書面授權矩陣或門禁記錄，往往在 FDA 查廠時被觀察到，特別是在涉及訪客或維修人員管理的場景。
blocks.en: Pattern 4: Unauthorized persons entering restricted areas. The access authorization requirement of §211.28(d), where there is no written authorization matrix or access control records, is often observed during FDA inspections, particularly in the management of visitors and maintenance personnel.

blocks.zh: §211.28(a) 的健康排除程序設計
blocks.en: Designing the Health Exclusion Procedure for §211.28(a)

blocks.zh: 法規要求建立書面程序處理以下情況：
blocks.en: The regulation requires a written procedure to address the following:

blocks.zh: 發燒、腹瀉、皮疹、開放性傷口、呼吸道感染等需申報的健康狀況清單
blocks.en: A list of reportable health conditions such as fever, diarrhea, rash, open wounds and respiratory infections

blocks.zh: 主管觀察到異常健康狀況的處理步驟
blocks.en: Steps for when a supervisor observes an abnormal health condition

blocks.zh: 復工前的醫療評估要求（「由合格醫療人員確認」）
blocks.en: Medical evaluation requirements before return to work ("confirmed by competent medical personnel")

blocks.zh: 記錄要求：健康排除事件需保留記錄嗎？（建議是，以便備查）
blocks.en: Record requirements: should health exclusion events be recorded? (Recommended, so that they are available for review)

blocks.zh: 無菌設施的額外考量： 一些公司要求無菌灌裝人員在感冒症狀期間必須停止進入 A/B 區操作，即使症狀輕微——這比 §211.28(a) 的「顯見疾病」標準更嚴格，符合 Annex 1 的精神。
blocks.en: Additional considerations for sterile facilities: Some companies require aseptic filling personnel to stop entering grade A/B areas for operations while they have cold symptoms, even if the symptoms are mild. This is stricter than the "apparent illness" standard of §211.28(a) and is consistent with the spirit of Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：§211.28 的「最低標準」邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Minimum Standard" Logic of §211.28

blocks.zh: 理解 §211.28 在法規層次結構中的位置，可以用食品安全的類比：§211.28 就像「食品衛生基本法」規定廚師不能在發燒時上班、必須戴髮網、勤洗手——這是所有食品處理環境的基準要求，從街頭攤販到米其林餐廳都適用。
blocks.en: The position of §211.28 in the regulatory hierarchy can be understood through a food safety analogy: §211.28 is like a "basic food hygiene law" that says cooks may not work with a fever, must wear hairnets and must wash their hands often. This is the baseline requirement for every food handling environment, applying from street-food stalls to Michelin-starred restaurants.

blocks.zh: 但手術室的衛生要求（無菌手術服、雙重手套、術前消毒程序）遠超基本食品衛生規定。同樣地，無菌藥品生產環境的人員要求（著裝資格確認、環境監控、A/B 區行為管制）遠超 §211.28 的文字要求——這些更高要求來自監管指引（FDA 無菌指引、EU Annex 1）和設施特定 SOP，而非 §211.28 本身。
blocks.en: But the hygiene requirements of an operating room (sterile surgical gowns, double gloves, pre-operative disinfection procedures) go far beyond basic food hygiene rules. Likewise, the personnel requirements of a sterile drug manufacturing environment (gowning qualification, environmental monitoring, behavioral controls in grade A/B areas) go far beyond the text of §211.28. These higher requirements come from regulatory guidance (FDA aseptic processing guidance, EU Annex 1) and facility-specific SOPs, not from §211.28 itself.

blocks.zh: 合規策略啟示： 撰寫無菌設施的人員衛生和著裝 SOP 時，不要以「符合 §211.28」為目標——應以「滿足 FDA 無菌指引第 X 節和 EU Annex 1 第 Y 節的要求」為目標，§211.28 的最低要求自然會被包含在內。
blocks.en: Compliance strategy takeaway: When writing personnel hygiene and gowning SOPs for a sterile facility, do not aim to "comply with §211.28." Aim to "meet the requirements of Section X of the FDA aseptic processing guidance and Section Y of EU Annex 1," and the minimum requirements of §211.28 will naturally be included.

blocks.zh: §211.28(d) 限制進入區域的合規設計
blocks.en: Compliant Design for Restricted-Area Access Under §211.28(d)

blocks.zh: 此條款要求有書面授權系統管控人員進入特定區域。實務設計：
blocks.en: This provision requires a written authorization system controlling personnel entry into specific areas. Practical design:

blocks.zh: 區域進入授權矩陣（Access Authorization Matrix）：列明各職位可進入的區域
blocks.en: Access Authorization Matrix: lists the areas each position may enter

blocks.zh: 電子門禁系統（如 Access Control System）的存取權限與 §211.68 的資料完整性要求結合
blocks.en: Access rights in electronic access control systems combined with the data integrity requirements of §211.68

blocks.zh: 訪客 / 維修人員進入紀錄：日期、時間、陪同人員、進入目的
blocks.en: Visitor / maintenance personnel entry records: date, time, escort, purpose of entry

blocks.zh: GMP 訓練作為進入授權前提條件
blocks.en: GMP training as a prerequisite for access authorization

blocks.zh: 個人電子設備（PED）與 §211.28(c)(d) 的交叉議題
blocks.en: Cross-Cutting Issue of Personal Electronic Devices (PEDs) with §211.28(c)(d)

blocks.zh: 近年來，個人電子設備（Personal Electronic Devices，包括手機、智慧手錶）進入製造區域已成為重要的 GMP 合規議題，橫跨 §211.28 和 §211.68：
blocks.en: In recent years, the entry of personal electronic devices (PEDs, including mobile phones and smart watches) into manufacturing areas has become a significant GMP compliance issue, spanning §211.28 and §211.68:

blocks.zh: §211.28(b)(c) — 著裝和衛生： 個人設備可能是交叉污染載體（表面微生物）。在無菌製造中，帶入個人設備違反著裝程序，且與「良好衛生習慣」的要求相悖。許多設施明確禁止在 C/D 級以上潔淨區使用個人設備。
blocks.en: §211.28(b)(c): Apparel and hygiene. Personal devices can be vectors of cross-contamination (surface microorganisms). In sterile manufacturing, bringing in a personal device violates gowning procedures and runs against the requirement for "good sanitation habits." Many facilities explicitly prohibit personal devices in cleanrooms of grade C/D and above.

blocks.zh: §211.28(d) — 進入授權： 進入授權程序應包含對攜帶物品（包括電子設備）的規定，而非僅針對人員本身。
blocks.en: §211.28(d): Access authorization. The access authorization procedure should cover items carried in (including electronic devices), not just the people themselves.

blocks.zh: §211.68 — 資料完整性： 個人手機拍攝 GMP 記錄或設備螢幕可能產生未受控制的電子副本，帶來資料完整性風險（未經授權的 GMP 記錄副本）。書面程序應明確禁止或嚴格限制在製造區域使用個人設備拍攝。
blocks.en: §211.68: Data integrity. Photographing GMP records or equipment screens with a personal phone can create uncontrolled electronic copies, a data integrity risk (unauthorized copies of GMP records). Written procedures should clearly prohibit, or strictly limit, the use of personal devices for photography in manufacturing areas.

blocks.zh: 書面 SOP 應整合處理上述三個面向，建立「製造區域電子設備管理程序」，並作為進入訓練的一部分向所有相關人員傳達。
blocks.en: A written SOP should address all three aspects together, establishing an "Electronic Device Management Procedure for Manufacturing Areas" and communicating it to all relevant personnel as part of entry training.

blocks.zh: 人員衛生要求三層結構對比：§211.28 / FDA 無菌指引 / EU Annex 1
blocks.en: Comparison of the Three Tiers of Personnel Hygiene Requirements: §211.28 / FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance / EU Annex 1

blocks.zh: 一名操作員手背有一道癒合中的割傷（有結痂但未完全癒合），可以進入無菌灌裝 B 區嗎？你會引用哪些法規和指引做出決定？
blocks.en: An operator has a healing cut on the back of the hand (scabbed but not fully healed). Can the operator enter the grade B area for aseptic filling? Which regulations and guidance would you cite in making the decision?

blocks.zh: §211.28(b) 說「如有必要（as necessary）」穿著防護服——誰來決定「必要性」？這個決定應如何書面化？
blocks.en: §211.28(b) says protective apparel must be worn "as necessary." Who decides what is "necessary," and how should the decision be documented?

blocks.zh: 一家同時面對 FDA 和 EMA 查廠的 CDMO，若其著裝程序只符合 §211.28 的最低要求，在 EU 查廠中可能面臨哪些發現？如何設計一套程序同時滿足兩套要求？
blocks.en: A CDMO facing both FDA and EMA inspections has a gowning procedure that meets only the minimum of §211.28. What findings might it face in an EU inspection? How would you design one procedure that satisfies both sets of requirements?

blocks.zh: 1.4 §211.34 — Consultants 1.4 §211.34 — 顧問
blocks.en: 1.4 §211.34 — Consultants
Who Is a "Consultant" Under §211.34?

blocks.zh: 這個問題在 CDMO 環境中比想像中複雜。FDA 對「顧問」的定義採功能性解釋，而非職銜或合約形式。判斷標準：這個外部人員是否就製造、加工、包裝或持有藥品提供建議？
blocks.en: This question is more complex in a CDMO setting than it appears. FDA defines "consultant" by functional interpretation, not by job title or contract form. The test is: does this outside person advise on the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drugs?

blocks.zh: 通常屬於 §211.34 顧問的情況：
blocks.en: Cases that are generally §211.34 consultants:

blocks.zh: 外聘的 GMP 顧問（協助準備 FDA 查廠）
blocks.en: An external GMP consultant (helping to prepare for an FDA inspection)

blocks.zh: 特聘的製程驗證專家（進行工藝驗證評估）
blocks.en: A process validation expert engaged specially (performing a process validation assessment)

blocks.zh: 無菌製造技術顧問（提供灌裝線改進建議）
blocks.en: An aseptic manufacturing technical consultant (advising on improvements to a filling line)

blocks.zh: 外部實驗室分析師（針對特定技術問題提供解釋意見）
blocks.en: An external laboratory analyst (giving interpretive opinions on a specific technical issue)

blocks.zh: 通常不屬於 §211.34 顧問的情況：
blocks.en: Cases that are generally not §211.34 consultants:

blocks.zh: 純粹提供設備的廠商技術人員（安裝、校正）
blocks.en: Vendor technicians who only supply equipment (installation, calibration)

blocks.zh: 法律顧問（提供法律建議，非 GMP 技術建議）
blocks.en: Legal counsel (providing legal advice, not GMP technical advice)

blocks.zh: IT 廠商（除非在提供 GMP 系統驗證建議）
blocks.en: IT vendors (unless they are advising on GMP system validation)

blocks.zh: 「顧問」資格要求的法規解析
blocks.en: Regulatory Analysis of the "Consultant" Qualification Requirements

blocks.zh: §211.34 與 §211.25(a) 使用幾乎相同的資格標準語言：「充分的教育、訓練、和經驗，或其任意組合（sufficient education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof）」。這不是巧合——FDA 的立場是，為製藥製造提供建議的外部專家應達到與內部人員相同的資格標準。
blocks.en: §211.34 uses almost the same qualification language as §211.25(a): "sufficient education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof." This is no coincidence: FDA's position is that outside experts who advise on pharmaceutical manufacturing should meet the same qualification standard as internal staff.

blocks.zh: 「顧問」的法規觸發點： 核心要素是「advising on」——只要外部人員就製造、加工、包裝、或持有藥品提供建議（無論是書面報告、口頭意見、還是現場指導），§211.34 就被觸發。以下幾個常見的邊界情況值得特別注意：
blocks.en: The regulatory trigger for a "consultant": The core element is "advising on." Whenever an outside person advises on the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drugs (whether through a written report, verbal opinion or on-site guidance), §211.34 is triggered. The following common borderline cases deserve special attention:

blocks.zh: 設備廠商技術支援： 廠商工程師到廠進行設備校正或維護 → 通常不構成 §211.34 顧問。但若廠商工程師同時就「如何設定設備參數以優化產品品質」提供建議 → 可能構成顧問。
blocks.en: Equipment vendor technical support: A vendor engineer who comes on site to calibrate or maintain equipment → generally not a §211.34 consultant. But if the vendor engineer also advises on "how to set equipment parameters to optimize product quality" → may be a consultant.

blocks.zh: 學術合作夥伴： 合作研究計劃中的大學教授，若就製程開發或改進提供具體技術建議 → 多數情況下構成 §211.34 顧問，即使未有正式顧問合約。
blocks.en: Academic partners: A university professor in a collaborative research program who gives specific technical advice on process development or improvement → in most cases a §211.34 consultant, even without a formal consulting contract.

blocks.zh: 客戶技術轉移人員： 委託方在技術轉移期間派駐技術人員，若這些人員就 CDMO 的製造操作提供指導 → 在 CDMO 的 §211.34 合規框架下，這些人員的資格應有記錄。
blocks.en: Client technology transfer staff: Technical staff the client stations at the site during technology transfer, if they give guidance on the CDMO's manufacturing operations → under the CDMO's §211.34 compliance framework, the qualifications of these people should be documented.

blocks.zh: 顧問記錄的實務建立方式
blocks.en: How to Set Up Consultant Records in Practice

blocks.zh: §211.34 要求的最低記錄要素：
blocks.en: Minimum record elements required by §211.34:

blocks.zh: 姓名（Name） — 完整法定姓名
blocks.en: Name — full legal name

blocks.zh: 地址（Address） — 業務聯絡地址
blocks.en: Address — business contact address

blocks.zh: 資格（Qualifications） — 教育學歷、相關工作經驗年資、專業認證（如有）
blocks.en: Qualifications — educational degrees, years of relevant work experience, professional certifications (if any)

blocks.zh: 服務類型（Type of Service） — 提供建議的具體 GMP 活動範圍
blocks.en: Type of Service — the specific scope of GMP activities on which advice is given

blocks.zh: 建議的最佳實踐： 建立「顧問資格登錄表（Consultant Qualification Log）」，格式化收集上述資料，並附上 CV 或資格文件副本。每次聘用顧問時更新。FDA 查廠時可即時提供。
blocks.en: Recommended best practice: Set up a "Consultant Qualification Log" that collects the above information in a standard format, with copies of the CV or qualification documents attached. Update it each time a consultant is engaged. It can then be produced immediately during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 服務合約中的 GMP 條款： 在顧問合約中明確列出服務範圍，便於確認是否觸發 §211.34 要求，也便於日後在記錄中引用「服務類型」。
blocks.en: GMP clauses in service contracts: State the scope of services clearly in the consulting contract. This makes it easier to confirm whether §211.34 requirements are triggered and to cite the "type of service" in the records later.

blocks.zh: §211.34 就像醫院聘用外科手術顧問的規定：你可以引進外部專家，但必須確認他有執照、有資格做這種手術，並且有記錄在案。藥廠引進顧問的邏輯相同——FDA 的立場是：「你引進的專家的建議影響了你的藥品品質，所以我需要知道這個人是否有足夠資格。」
blocks.en: §211.34 is like the rule for a hospital engaging a surgical consultant: you may bring in an outside expert, but you must confirm that the person is licensed and qualified for this kind of surgery, and keep a record of it. The same logic applies to a drug maker engaging a consultant. FDA's position is: "The advice of the expert you bring in affects the quality of your drug, so I need to know whether this person is sufficiently qualified."

blocks.zh: CDMO 查廠常見問題
blocks.en: Common Questions in CDMO Inspections

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時針對 §211.34 的典型問題：
blocks.en: Typical FDA questions on §211.34 during an inspection:

blocks.zh: 「你們過去兩年有使用過 GMP 顧問嗎？請給我看顧問記錄。」
blocks.en: "Have you used any GMP consultants in the past two years? Please show me the consultant records."

blocks.zh: 如果顧問記錄缺失或不完整 → 483 觀察（違反 §211.34）
blocks.en: If consultant records are missing or incomplete → 483 observation (violation of §211.34)

blocks.zh: 如果顧問的資格文件不足以支持其所提供的建議範圍 → 更嚴重的觀察
blocks.en: If a consultant's qualification documents are insufficient to support the scope of advice given → a more serious observation

blocks.zh: CDMO 特殊情境： 當客戶派遣自己的 QA 人員到 CDMO 提供「技術指導」時，這些人員是否構成 §211.34 顧問？取決於服務性質。如果客戶 QA 在現場就 CDMO 的製造操作提供 GMP 建議 → 可能需要納入顧問記錄。Quality Agreement 應澄清此情況。
blocks.en: Special CDMO situation: When a client sends its own QA staff to the CDMO to provide "technical guidance," are those people §211.34 consultants? It depends on the nature of the service. If client QA staff give GMP advice on the CDMO's manufacturing operations on site → they may need to be included in the consultant records. The Quality Agreement should clarify this.

blocks.zh: Warning Letter 等級的風險： 如果顧問沒有足夠資格而 CDMO 仍採納其建議，並且該建議導致了品質問題或 CGMP 缺失，FDA 可能在 Warning Letter 中引用 §211.34 作為系統性缺失的一部分。顧問記錄問題單獨出現通常是 483 等級；若結合「不合格顧問的建議導致品質系統缺失」，可能升級為 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: Warning Letter-level risk: If a consultant is not adequately qualified and the CDMO nonetheless follows the advice, and that advice leads to a quality problem or CGMP deficiency, FDA may cite §211.34 in a Warning Letter as part of a systemic deficiency. Consultant record problems alone are usually at the 483 level; combined with "advice from an unqualified consultant led to quality system deficiencies," they may escalate to a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 聘用前 FDA 查廠官員作為 FDA 查廠準備顧問。這是否需要 §211.34 記錄？需要記錄哪些資格文件？
blocks.en: A CDMO hires a former FDA investigator as a consultant to prepare for FDA inspections. Are §211.34 records required? Which qualification documents need to be recorded?

blocks.zh: 一位大學教授受邀就特定滅菌工藝問題提供一次性技術意見（未收取費用）。這算 §211.34 顧問嗎？「收費與否」是判斷標準嗎？
blocks.en: A university professor is invited to give one-time technical advice on a specific sterilization process issue (unpaid). Is this a §211.34 consultant? Is "whether payment is made" the criterion?

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員要求看「過去兩年所有顧問的記錄」。你的顧問登錄表只有三個人，但你確信公司還使用了其他外部技術支援。查廠應對策略是什麼？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator asks to see "the records of all consultants for the past two years." Your consultant log has only three people, but you are sure the company has used other external technical support. What is your inspection response strategy?

blocks.zh: 1.5 §211.68 — Automatic, Mechanical, and Electronic Equipment 1.5 §211.68 — 自動化、機械與電子設備
blocks.en: 1.5 §211.68 — Automatic, Mechanical, and Electronic Equipment

blocks.zh: §211.68 是電子系統進入 CGMP 合規的入口
blocks.en: §211.68 Is the Entry Point for Electronic Systems into CGMP Compliance

blocks.zh: §211.68 是 Part 211 中最能與現代製藥 IT 基礎設施連結的條款。它建立了電子設備（包括電腦系統）的基本 CGMP 要求，而 21 CFR Part 11 則在其基礎上建立了更完整的電子記錄 / 電子簽名框架。
blocks.en: §211.68 is the provision of Part 211 that connects most directly to modern pharmaceutical IT infrastructure. It establishes the basic CGMP requirements for electronic equipment (including computer systems), while 21 CFR Part 11 builds on it to provide a fuller framework for electronic records and electronic signatures.

blocks.zh: 三層合規框架：
blocks.en: Three-tier compliance framework:

blocks.zh: 層次 1 — §211.68： 校正、維護、存取控制、備份的基本 CGMP 要求（所有藥廠均適用）
blocks.en: Tier 1, §211.68: Basic CGMP requirements for calibration, maintenance, access control and backup (applicable to all drug manufacturers)

blocks.zh: 層次 2 — 21 CFR Part 11： 電子記錄和電子簽名的詳細要求（適用於以電子形式維護的 GMP 記錄）
blocks.en: Tier 2, 21 CFR Part 11: Detailed requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures (applicable to GMP records maintained in electronic form)

blocks.zh: 層次 3 — CSV（Computer System Validation）： FDA 指引要求對影響產品品質的電腦化系統進行驗證（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: Tier 3, CSV (Computer System Validation): FDA guidance expects validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) of computerized systems that affect product quality

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 與 ALCOA+ 資料完整性框架
blocks.en: §211.68(b) and the ALCOA+ Data Integrity Framework

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 對電腦系統的存取控制要求直接對應 ALCOA+ 資料完整性原則：
blocks.en: The access control requirements for computer systems in §211.68(b) map directly onto the ALCOA+ data integrity principles:

blocks.zh: A — Attributable（可歸因）： 每一筆記錄變更都必須能追溯到特定的授權人員
blocks.en: A: Attributable. Every change to a record must be traceable to a specific authorized person

blocks.zh: L — Legible（可讀性）： 記錄必須清晰可讀，電子記錄需有適當的顯示和列印功能
blocks.en: L: Legible. Records must be clearly readable, and electronic records need appropriate display and print functions

blocks.zh: C — Contemporaneous（同步性）： 操作發生時即時記錄，不允許事後補錄
blocks.en: C: Contemporaneous. Record at the time the activity is performed; back-filling after the fact is not permitted

blocks.zh: O — Original（原始性）： 原始資料不可被覆蓋；§211.68(b) 的備份要求直接支持此原則
blocks.en: O: Original. Original data must not be overwritten; the backup requirement of §211.68(b) directly supports this principle

blocks.zh: A — Accurate（準確性）： 輸入/輸出驗證（§211.68(b)）確保數據準確
blocks.en: A: Accurate. Input/output verification (§211.68(b)) ensures the data are accurate

blocks.zh: + 附加：Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available
blocks.en: + Additional: Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available
Frequent 483 Observations on §211.68

blocks.zh: 以下是 FDA 針對電腦系統和自動化設備最常引用的缺失：
blocks.en: The following are the deficiencies FDA cites most often for computer systems and automated equipment:

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）缺失或未被審查： 系統有稽核追蹤功能但未啟用，或有啟用但定期審查程序不存在
blocks.en: Audit trail missing or not reviewed: The system has audit trail functionality but it is not enabled, or it is enabled but no procedure exists for periodic review

blocks.zh: 共用帳號（Shared Accounts）： 多名人員使用同一個登入帳號 → 無法滿足「只有授權人員才能修改記錄」的可歸因要求
blocks.en: Shared accounts: Several people use the same login account → cannot satisfy the attributability requirement that "only authorized personnel may change records"

blocks.zh: 管理員帳號管理不當： 系統管理員帳號被用於日常操作，或離職員工帳號未及時停用
blocks.en: Poor administrator account management: The system administrator account is used for routine operations, or accounts of departed employees are not disabled promptly

blocks.zh: 備份程序缺失： 未建立書面的資料備份程序，或備份沒有被定期測試恢復
blocks.en: No backup procedure: There is no written data backup procedure, or backups are not periodically tested for restoration

blocks.zh: 校正記錄不完整： 設備有校正標籤但書面校正記錄缺失或不完整
blocks.en: Incomplete calibration records: Equipment bears a calibration label but the written calibration record is missing or incomplete

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 「輸入/輸出驗證」的實務意涵
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of "Input/Output Verification" Under §211.68(b)

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 要求根據電腦系統的「複雜性和可靠性」決定輸入/輸出驗證的程度和頻率。這一要求在實務中往往被簡化為「系統驗證（CSV）完成就夠了」——但 CSV 是一次性驗證，而 §211.68(b) 的 I/O 驗證是持續運行期間的日常品質控制。
blocks.en: §211.68(b) requires that the degree and frequency of input/output verification be based on the "complexity and reliability" of the computer system. In practice this requirement is often simplified to "completing system validation (CSV) is enough." But CSV is a one-time validation, whereas I/O verification under §211.68(b) is routine quality control during ongoing operation.

blocks.zh: I/O 驗證的實際應用範例：
blocks.en: Practical examples of I/O verification:

blocks.zh: LIMS 計算公式驗證： 每當 LIMS 升級或計算公式修改後，用已知結果的樣本重新驗證輸出準確性
blocks.en: LIMS calculation formula verification: Each time the LIMS is upgraded or a calculation formula is modified, re-verify output accuracy using samples with known results

blocks.zh: 批次記錄系統資料轉移驗證： 從 MES 轉入批次記錄的生產參數，抽樣核對原始 SCADA 數據與 MES 記錄的一致性
blocks.en: Batch record system data transfer verification: For production parameters transferred from the MES into the batch record, sample and check that the original SCADA data agree with the MES record

blocks.zh: 分析儀器數位輸出核對： 儀器數位輸出的計算結果（如 HPLC 面積積分計算的濃度），定期用手動計算核對演算法準確性
blocks.en: Verification of digital outputs from analytical instruments: For results calculated from an instrument's digital output (such as concentration from HPLC peak area integration), periodically check the accuracy of the algorithm against manual calculation

blocks.zh: ERP 庫存系統數量核對： 系統中的物料庫存量與實際庫存的週期性盤點
blocks.en: ERP inventory quantity reconciliation: Periodic cycle counts of material inventory in the system against actual stock

blocks.zh: 頻率不需要是每天——§211.68(b) 明確允許根據複雜性和可靠性調整。一個高度穩定、已有多年驗證歷史的 LIMS 可能半年一次 I/O 抽查就足夠；一個新部署的系統可能需要月度驗證。關鍵是：頻率決定必須有書面依據（風險評估），而非隨機的。
blocks.en: The frequency does not need to be daily; §211.68(b) explicitly allows it to be adjusted according to complexity and reliability. A highly stable LIMS with a validated history of many years may need only a semi-annual I/O spot check, while a newly deployed system may need monthly verification. The key point is that the frequency decision must have a documented basis (risk assessment) and must not be arbitrary.

blocks.zh: CSV（電腦化系統驗證）與 §211.68 的關係
blocks.en: The Relationship Between CSV (Computerized System Validation) and §211.68

blocks.zh: §211.68(a) 要求「確保設備正確執行功能（proper performance）」的書面程序。FDA 在多份指引文件中將這一要求解釋為包含電腦化系統的驗證（Validation）：
blocks.en: §211.68(a) requires written procedures to "assure proper performance" of equipment. In several guidance documents FDA interprets this requirement as including validation of computerized systems:

blocks.zh: 1983 年 FDA 軟體政策： 要求對影響產品品質的電腦化系統進行驗證
blocks.en: 1983 FDA software policy: Requires validation of computerized systems that affect product quality

blocks.zh: 2003 年 21 CFR Part 11 scope guidance： 確認 CSV 是 predicate rule 要求（§211.68），Part 11 是「如何記錄」的要求
blocks.en: 2003 21 CFR Part 11 scope guidance: Confirms that CSV is a predicate rule requirement (§211.68) and that Part 11 addresses "how to record"

blocks.zh: GAMP 5（2022）： ISPE 發布的電腦化系統驗證最佳實踐，被 FDA 廣泛引用
blocks.en: GAMP 5 (2022): ISPE's best practice guide for computerized system validation, widely referenced by FDA

blocks.zh: 實務意涵： 系統驗證文件（URS、風險評估、IQ/OQ/PQ、CVR）是 §211.68 合規的核心書面證明，而非可選的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: Practical implication: System validation documents (URS, risk assessment, IQ/OQ/PQ, CVR) are the core written evidence of §211.68 compliance, not an optional best practice.

blocks.zh: §211.68(a) 校正計畫的風險分層設計
blocks.en: Risk-Tiered Design of the §211.68(a) Calibration Program

blocks.zh: 並非所有設備都需要同樣嚴格的校正計劃。以風險為基礎的設備分層（Equipment Criticality Classification）是業界最佳實踐，也符合 §211.68(a) 的設計精神：
blocks.en: Not all equipment needs an equally rigorous calibration program. Risk-based equipment classification (Equipment Criticality Classification) is industry best practice and is consistent with the design intent of §211.68(a):

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備（Direct Impact）： 直接影響產品品質或安全性的設備（如高壓滅菌器溫度感測器、無菌灌裝機稱重系統）。校正頻率最高，通常每 3-6 個月；失效立即觸發影響評估；須有 NIST 可追溯的校正標準。
blocks.en: Critical equipment (Direct Impact): Equipment that directly affects product quality or safety (such as autoclave temperature sensors and aseptic filling machine weighing systems). Highest calibration frequency, usually every 3-6 months; a failure immediately triggers an impact assessment; NIST-traceable calibration standards are required.

blocks.zh: 間接影響設備（Indirect Impact）： 間接影響品質（如監控環境但非製程參數的設備）。校正頻率可適當延長（每 6-12 個月）；失效觸發調查但不一定立即停產。
blocks.en: Indirect-impact equipment (Indirect Impact): Equipment that affects quality indirectly (such as equipment that monitors the environment but not process parameters). Calibration frequency can reasonably be extended (every 6-12 months); a failure triggers an investigation but not necessarily an immediate stop to production.

blocks.zh: 無影響設備（No Impact）： 對產品品質無影響的設備（如辦公室電腦）。可不納入 GMP 校正計劃，但需記錄分類依據。
blocks.en: No-impact equipment (No Impact): Equipment with no effect on product quality (such as office computers). May be excluded from the GMP calibration program, but the basis for the classification must be documented.

blocks.zh: 設備分類決定應有書面依據（風險評估），並由 QCU 依 §211.22(c) 核准。校正計劃是製造主計劃（Master Validation Plan）的一部分，在 FDA 查廠時往往是首批被要求查閱的文件之一。
blocks.en: The equipment classification decision should have a documented basis (risk assessment) and be approved by the QCU under §211.22(c). The calibration program is part of the Master Validation Plan, and it is often one of the first documents requested during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：三層合規框架
blocks.en: Analogy: The Three-Tier Compliance Framework

blocks.zh: 想像一棟建築物的安全體系：
blocks.en: Imagine the safety system of a building:

blocks.zh: §211.68 = 建築法規（Building Code）： 所有建築物都必須符合的最低安全標準。規定你必須有滅火設備（校正）、緊急出口（備份）和門鎖（存取控制）。
blocks.en: §211.68 = the Building Code: The minimum safety standard every building must meet. It says you must have fire-fighting equipment (calibration), emergency exits (backup) and door locks (access control).

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 = 保全系統規範： 如果你決定用電子門禁代替傳統鑰匙，那你的電子系統必須符合這套更詳細的保全規範（稽核追蹤、電子簽名等）。
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 = the security system specification: If you decide to replace traditional keys with electronic access control, your electronic system must meet this more detailed security specification (audit trail, electronic signatures and so on).

blocks.zh: CSV / GAMP 5 = 保全系統安裝與測試標準： 你的電子門禁在投入使用前必須被正確安裝（IQ）、功能測試（OQ）並在實際使用條件下驗證（PQ）。
blocks.en: CSV / GAMP 5 = the security system installation and testing standard: Before your electronic access control is put into use, it must be correctly installed (IQ), functionally tested (OQ) and verified under actual use conditions (PQ).

blocks.zh: 如果一家藥廠說「我的 LIMS 沒有稽核追蹤，因為我只需要符合 §211.68，不需要符合 Part 11」——這個論點可能成立，但前提是 LIMS 的數據不是「以電子形式維護的 GMP 記錄」。在實踐中，幾乎所有現代 LIMS 都是 Part 11 記錄系統，這個例外極難成立。
blocks.en: If a drug maker says, "My LIMS has no audit trail because I only need to comply with §211.68, not Part 11," the argument may hold, but only if the LIMS data are not "GMP records maintained in electronic form." In practice, almost every modern LIMS is a Part 11 record system, and this exception is extremely hard to sustain.

blocks.zh: 新興技術挑戰：AI / 機器學習系統的 §211.68 合規
blocks.en: Emerging Technology Challenge: §211.68 Compliance for AI / Machine Learning Systems

blocks.zh: 隨著 AI 系統進入製藥製造（如：自動異常偵測、預測性維護、AI 輔助放行審查），§211.68 的「校正、維護、存取控制」框架面臨新的解釋挑戰：
blocks.en: As AI systems enter pharmaceutical manufacturing (for example automated anomaly detection, predictive maintenance and AI-assisted release review), the "calibration, maintenance and access control" framework of §211.68 faces new interpretive challenges:

blocks.zh: AI 模型的「校正」是什麼？ 傳統校正針對測量儀器的精確度。AI 模型的「校正」可能意味著定期再訓練（retraining）和效能驗證，確保模型在新生產數據下仍然準確。
blocks.en: What is "calibration" for an AI model? Traditional calibration addresses the accuracy of measuring instruments. "Calibration" of an AI model may mean periodic retraining and performance verification to ensure the model is still accurate on new production data.

blocks.zh: AI 決策的稽核追蹤： 如果 AI 系統建議放行或拒絕某個批次，§211.68(b) 的存取控制要求意味著這個建議必須由授權人員確認，而非 AI 自動執行。人的監督層不可省略。
blocks.en: Audit trail of AI decisions: If an AI system recommends releasing or rejecting a batch, the access control requirement of §211.68(b) means the recommendation must be confirmed by an authorized person and not executed automatically by the AI. The layer of human oversight cannot be omitted.

blocks.zh: FDA 2024 AI/ML 草案指引： FDA 正在制定 AI 在藥品製造中的監管框架，預期會在現有 §211.68 和 CSV 框架基礎上增加 AI 特定要求（模型風險評估、持續效能監控）。
blocks.en: FDA's 2024 AI/ML draft guidance: FDA is developing a regulatory framework for AI in drug manufacturing, and it is expected to add AI-specific requirements (model risk assessment, continuous performance monitoring) on top of the existing §211.68 and CSV framework.

blocks.zh: 目前 §211.68 仍是 AI 系統進入 GMP 合規框架的基礎法規入口。
blocks.en: For now, §211.68 remains the foundational regulatory entry point for bringing AI systems into the GMP compliance framework.

blocks.zh: §211.68 vs 21 CFR Part 11 要求對比
blocks.en: Comparison of §211.68 vs. 21 CFR Part 11 Requirements

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 的「備份例外」條款解析
blocks.en: The "Backup Exception" Clause of §211.68(b)

blocks.zh: §211.68(b) 包含一個重要的例外子句：「除了某些數據（如實驗室分析中執行的計算）因電腦化而不再必要」。這一「備份例外」常被誤解。
blocks.en: §211.68(b) contains an important exception clause: "except those components of the data that are not necessary because of computerization." This "backup exception" is often misunderstood.

blocks.zh: 例外的含義： 在早期電腦化時代，LIMS 會自動計算分析師手動輸入的原始數值（如吸光度）。如果 LIMS 儲存了計算結果，分析師也在紙本上記了同樣的計算，那紙本副本就是「因電腦化而不再必要的冗餘備份」——可以省略。例外針對的是冗餘副本，而非主要原始數據。
blocks.en: Meaning of the exception: In the early era of computerization, a LIMS would automatically calculate raw values entered manually by the analyst (such as absorbance). If the LIMS stored the calculated result and the analyst also recorded the same calculation on paper, the paper copy was a "redundant backup made unnecessary by computerization" and could be omitted. The exception targets redundant copies, not primary raw data.

blocks.zh: 例外不適用的情況： 如果電腦是原始數據的唯一來源（如 HPLC 色譜圖），就不存在「冗餘」——電子原始數據必須備份。這種情況下，§211.68(b) 的備份要求和 Part 11 的記錄保護要求都是必要的，沒有例外可言。
blocks.en: Where the exception does not apply: If the computer is the sole source of the raw data (such as an HPLC chromatogram), there is no "redundancy," so the electronic raw data must be backed up. In that case both the backup requirement of §211.68(b) and the record protection requirements of Part 11 are necessary, and there is no exception to speak of.

blocks.zh: FDA 2018 資料完整性指引的立場： 明確說明原始電子數據不應以「例外」為由省略備份。例外僅適用於因電子化而真正消失（不再產生）的冗餘紙本副本，不適用於任何原始數據。
blocks.en: Position of FDA's 2018 data integrity guidance: It states explicitly that original electronic data should not be left without a backup on the grounds of the "exception." The exception applies only to redundant paper copies that genuinely disappear (are no longer generated) because of computerization, and does not apply to any original data.

blocks.zh: 資料完整性執法歷史：從 §211.68(b) 到數據完整性 Warning Letter 浪潮
blocks.en: Data Integrity Enforcement History: From §211.68(b) to the Wave of Data Integrity Warning Letters

blocks.zh: 2013 年以後，FDA 對電子系統資料完整性的執法力度大幅加強，根源就在於 §211.68(b) 長期被忽視。主要執法模式：
blocks.en: After 2013, FDA's enforcement on data integrity of electronic systems increased sharply, and the root of it lies in the long neglect of §211.68(b). Main enforcement patterns:

blocks.zh: 2013-2017 印度/中國 CDMO 浪潮： FDA 在大量境外檢查中發現：使用非稽核追蹤 HPLC 軟體（如未授權的 Empower 或 ChemStation 版本）、刪除失敗的測試結果、使用共用帳號運行分析。這些行為直接違反 §211.68(b) 的存取控制和記錄完整性要求。
blocks.en: 2013-2017 wave of India/China CDMOs: In many overseas inspections FDA found HPLC software used without an audit trail (such as unauthorized versions of Empower or ChemStation), failing test results deleted, and analyses run under shared accounts. These practices directly violate the access control and record integrity requirements of §211.68(b).

blocks.zh: FDA 2018「Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP」指引： 針對 §211.68(b) 和 21 CFR Part 11 的整合解釋，明確指出稽核追蹤是「預期」的合規要素，即使 §211.68(b) 未明確使用「audit trail」一詞。
blocks.en: FDA's 2018 "Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP" guidance: Provides an integrated interpretation of §211.68(b) and 21 CFR Part 11, stating clearly that an audit trail is an "expected" element of compliance even though §211.68(b) does not use the term "audit trail."

blocks.zh: 典型 Warning Letter 語言： "Your firm failed to exercise appropriate controls over computer-related systems... Specifically, your HPLC data system did not have audit trails enabled, allowing analysts to delete and overwrite raw data without creating a permanent record of these actions."
blocks.en: Typical Warning Letter language: "Your firm failed to exercise appropriate controls over computer-related systems... Specifically, your HPLC data system did not have audit trails enabled, allowing analysts to delete and overwrite raw data without creating a permanent record of these actions."

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示： §211.68(b) 的「存取控制」要求是資料完整性合規的法規基礎。任何允許未授權人員修改 GMP 記錄的電子系統，都是直接的 §211.68(b) 違規，不需要引用 Part 11 就可以出 483 或 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: Lesson for CDMOs: The "access control" requirement of §211.68(b) is the regulatory foundation of data integrity compliance. Any electronic system that allows unauthorized personnel to modify GMP records is a direct violation of §211.68(b), and a 483 or Warning Letter can be issued without citing Part 11.

blocks.zh: 一台 HPLC 儀器使用電腦控制軟體，數據直接儲存在電腦硬碟。這台設備需要符合 §211.68(a) 的哪些要求？是否也需要符合 21 CFR Part 11？判斷的關鍵前提是什麼？
blocks.en: An HPLC instrument uses computer control software and the data are stored directly on the computer's hard drive. Which §211.68(a) requirements must this equipment meet? Must it also comply with 21 CFR Part 11? What is the key precondition for deciding?

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠時發現你的 ERP 系統允許生產部門直接修改已核准的批次製造記錄，且沒有 QA 核准程序。這違反了 §211.68(b) 的哪個具體要求？
blocks.en: During an inspection FDA finds that your ERP system allows the production department to modify approved batch manufacturing records directly, with no QA approval procedure. Which specific requirement of §211.68(b) does this violate?

blocks.zh: 你公司的 LIMS 供應商說系統「自動備份」，但你沒有書面程序和測試記錄。在 §211.68(b) 下，這是合規的嗎？
blocks.en: Your company's LIMS vendor says the system "backs up automatically," but you have no written procedure and no test records. Is this compliant under §211.68(b)?

blocks.zh: 一台舊型溫度記錄儀使用紙帶圖表輸出。這是否仍在 §211.68 的範圍內？若是，需要哪些書面記錄？若公司想將其更換為電子溫度感測器，需要增加哪些合規步驟？
blocks.en: An old temperature recorder uses a paper chart output. Is it still within the scope of §211.68? If so, what written records are needed? If the company wants to replace it with an electronic temperature sensor, what additional compliance steps are needed?

blocks.zh: Subpart B 條款整合：五項核心要求如何相互支撐
blocks.en: Integration of Subpart B Provisions: How the Five Core Requirements Support Each Other

blocks.zh: Subpart B 系統性視角
blocks.en: Subpart B: A Systems View

blocks.zh: §§211.22–211.68 不是五個孤立的合規要求，而是一個相互支撐的組織品質系統：
blocks.en: §§211.22-211.68 are not five isolated compliance requirements but an interlocking organizational quality system:

blocks.zh: §211.22（QCU） 是整個系統的中樞——所有其他要求的執行和監督都回歸到 QCU 的核准和審查職責
blocks.en: §211.22 (QCU) is the hub of the whole system: the execution and oversight of all other requirements come back to the QCU's approval and review responsibilities

blocks.zh: §211.25（人員資格） 是 QCU 有效運作的基礎——QCU 本身的人員必須合格，才能有效審查生產活動
blocks.en: §211.25 (personnel qualifications) is the foundation for the QCU to operate effectively: the QCU's own staff must be qualified in order to review production activities effectively

blocks.zh: §211.28（人員健康衛生） 是所有人員要求的最低保護層，防止人員成為產品污染源
blocks.en: §211.28 (personnel health and hygiene) is the minimum protective layer for all personnel requirements, preventing people from becoming a source of product contamination

blocks.zh: §211.34（顧問） 將外部知識引入組織時的資格控制——確保外部建議的品質
blocks.en: §211.34 (consultants) is the qualification control applied when outside knowledge is brought into the organization, ensuring the quality of external advice

blocks.zh: §211.68（設備） 確保組織依賴的工具（電子系統和自動化設備）提供可信賴的數據和記錄，支撐 QCU 的審查決策
blocks.en: §211.68 (equipment) ensures that the tools the organization relies on (electronic systems and automated equipment) provide trustworthy data and records that support the QCU's review decisions

blocks.zh: 當 FDA 發現一家設施有系統性的 CGMP 問題時，通常可以在這五個條款中找到互相呼應的多個缺失——而非只有一個孤立的違規。這也是為什麼 Subpart B 被視為評估藥廠「品質文化成熟度」的關鍵窗口。
blocks.en: When FDA finds systemic CGMP problems at a facility, it can usually find several mutually reinforcing deficiencies across these five provisions, not just one isolated violation. This is also why Subpart B is regarded as a key window for assessing the maturity of a drug maker's quality culture.

blocks.zh: 關鍵法規詞彙速查
blocks.en: Quick Reference of Key Regulatory Terms

blocks.zh: Quality Control Unit (QCU) — 負責品質控制職責的人員或組織單元（§211.22）
blocks.en: Quality Control Unit (QCU) — the person or organizational element responsible for quality control duties (§211.22)

blocks.zh: Batch Record Review — QCU 審查批次生產和控制記錄以確認無錯誤（§211.22(a)）
blocks.en: Batch Record Review — QCU review of batch production and control records to confirm they are error-free (§211.22(a))

blocks.zh: Continuing GMP Training — 以足夠頻率持續進行的 CGMP 教育（§211.25(a)）
blocks.en: Continuing GMP Training — ongoing CGMP education conducted with sufficient frequency (§211.25(a))

blocks.zh: Competency Assessment — 確認員工具備執行職務所需能力的評估（§211.25 的最佳實踐）
blocks.en: Competency Assessment — an assessment confirming that an employee has the ability needed to perform the job (best practice under §211.25)

blocks.zh: Health Exclusion — 將顯見患病人員從直接接觸藥品的工作中排除（§211.28(a)）
blocks.en: Health Exclusion — removing personnel with apparent illness from work that involves direct contact with drug products (§211.28(a))

blocks.zh: Gowning Qualification — 確認人員正確執行著裝程序的評估（§211.28(b) 最佳實踐）
blocks.en: Gowning Qualification — an assessment confirming that personnel perform the gowning procedure correctly (best practice under §211.28(b))

blocks.zh: Consultant Qualification Record — §211.34 要求的顧問姓名、地址、資格、服務類型書面記錄
blocks.en: Consultant Qualification Record — the written record of consultant name, address, qualifications and type of service required by §211.34

blocks.zh: Calibration Program — 確保設備校正準確性的書面程序和記錄系統（§211.68(a)）
blocks.en: Calibration Program — the written procedures and record system that ensure equipment calibration accuracy (§211.68(a))

blocks.zh: Audit Trail — 電腦系統生成的操作記錄，追蹤誰在何時做了何種更改（§211.68(b)）
blocks.en: Audit Trail — a computer system-generated record of operations that tracks who made what change and when (§211.68(b))

blocks.zh: ALCOA+ — 資料完整性框架：Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available
blocks.en: ALCOA+ — a data integrity framework: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available

blocks.zh: Subparts A–B 綜合應用：組織設計決策矩陣
blocks.en: Combined Application of Subparts A-B: Organizational Design Decision Matrix

blocks.zh: 組織架構設計的合規考量
blocks.en: Compliance Considerations in Organizational Design

blocks.zh: 當一家新藥廠或 CDMO 設計其組織架構時，Subpart B（§§211.22–211.68）的要求應驅動以下關鍵組織設計決策：
blocks.en: When a new drug maker or CDMO designs its organization, the requirements of Subpart B (§§211.22-211.68) should drive the following key organizational design decisions:

blocks.zh: 決策 1 — QCU 匯報線： QCU 負責人應向 CEO 或董事會層級（而非生產或商業部門）匯報，以確保 §211.22(a) 的獨立性要求在組織架構上得到體現。在矩陣式管理的大型跨國公司中，QCU 負責人通常同時向本地總裁和全球品質長雙線匯報。
blocks.en: Decision 1, QCU reporting line: The head of the QCU should report to the CEO or board level (not to production or commercial functions), so that the independence requirement of §211.22(a) is reflected in the organizational structure. In large multinational companies with matrix management, the head of the QCU typically has a dual reporting line to both the local president and the global Chief Quality Officer.

blocks.zh: 決策 2 — QCU 資源規劃： §211.22(b) 的「足夠實驗室設施」要求意味著實驗室空間、設備和人員（§211.25(c)）都必須在業務規劃早期被分配。在新廠投資規劃中，QC 實驗室的面積和設備清單應作為設施設計的固定要素，而非預算壓縮時優先刪減的項目。
blocks.en: Decision 2, QCU resource planning: The "adequate laboratory facilities" requirement of §211.22(b) means laboratory space, equipment and staff (§211.25(c)) must all be allocated early in business planning. In new site investment planning, the QC laboratory footprint and equipment list should be fixed elements of facility design, not the first items cut when the budget is squeezed.

blocks.zh: 決策 3 — 訓練系統建立時序： §211.25 要求在人員開始操作前即達到合格標準。因此，訓練系統（學習管理系統 LMS、訓練矩陣、OJT 評估協議）必須在商業製造開始之前完成建立和驗證，而非在生產開始後追溯補建。
blocks.en: Decision 3, timing of training system setup: §211.25 requires personnel to meet the qualification standard before they begin operations. The training system (learning management system or LMS, training matrix, OJT assessment protocols) must therefore be established and validated before commercial manufacturing starts, not built retroactively after production begins.

blocks.zh: 決策 4 — 電子系統採購策略： §211.68 和 21 CFR Part 11 對電子系統的要求，應在採購決策時（而非實施後）作為關鍵需求納入 URS（使用者需求規格書）。「後補合規（retrofit compliance）」是業界成本最高的錯誤之一。
blocks.en: Decision 4, electronic system procurement strategy: The requirements of §211.68 and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic systems should be included as key requirements in the URS (User Requirements Specification) at the purchasing decision, not after implementation. "Retrofit compliance" is one of the most expensive mistakes in the industry.

blocks.zh: 查廠就緒度自我評估
blocks.en: Inspection Readiness Self-Assessment

blocks.zh: Subpart A–B 查廠就緒度自我檢核表
blocks.en: Subpart A-B Inspection Readiness Self-Check List

blocks.zh: 在 FDA 查廠前，確認以下問題的答案均為「是」：
blocks.en: Before an FDA inspection, confirm that the answers to all of the following are "yes":

blocks.zh: QCU 組織架構圖是否清楚顯示 QCU 負責人的匯報線不通過生產部門？
blocks.en: Does the QCU organization chart clearly show that the QCU head's reporting line does not pass through production?

blocks.zh: QCU 書面 SOP（§211.22(d)）是否涵蓋所有放行和審查活動，且版本受控？
blocks.en: Do the written QCU SOPs (§211.22(d)) cover all release and review activities, and are they version-controlled?

blocks.zh: 所有員工的訓練記錄是否包含其目前使用的 SOP 的最新版本？
blocks.en: Do all employees' training records include the latest version of the SOPs they currently use?

blocks.zh: 持續 CGMP 訓練記錄是否顯示「足夠頻率」的執行歷史（通常 ≥ 每年）？
blocks.en: Do the continuing CGMP training records show a history of "sufficient frequency" (usually ≥ annually)?

blocks.zh: 過去兩年所有 GMP 顧問是否均有書面資格記錄（姓名、地址、資格、服務類型）？
blocks.en: Do all GMP consultants from the past two years have written qualification records (name, address, qualifications, type of service)?

blocks.zh: 健康排除程序是否有書面 SOP，且有執行記錄（即使從未啟動過，至少要有訓練記錄）？
blocks.en: Is there a written SOP for health exclusion, with records of its execution (even if never invoked, there should at least be training records)?

blocks.zh: 潔淨區 / 限制區域是否有書面的進入授權矩陣和訪客記錄程序？
blocks.en: Do cleanroom / restricted areas have a written access authorization matrix and a visitor record procedure?

blocks.zh: 所有 GMP 相關電子設備是否有最新的校正記錄和校正狀態標籤？
blocks.en: Does all GMP-related electronic equipment have current calibration records and calibration status labels?

blocks.zh: 電腦系統是否有啟用稽核追蹤，且有定期審查程序和記錄？
blocks.en: Do computer systems have audit trails enabled, with a periodic review procedure and records?

blocks.zh: 資料備份程序是否有書面記錄，且備份恢復測試定期執行並有記錄？
blocks.en: Is the data backup procedure documented, with backup restoration tests performed periodically and recorded?

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: QCU 獨立性是 CGMP 核心： §211.22 要求 QCU 在組織上獨立於生產，具有不受干預的批次放行/拒絕權力。QCU 的職權橫跨所有產品類型（原料、在製品、成品）、所有程序與規格的核准、以及查閱所有生產記錄的權力。在合約製造中，受託方（CDMO）的 QCU 對所有受託批次負有獨立的放行責任，不能以客戶有自己 QA 為由卸責。Quality Agreement 必須清楚界定 QCU 職責分工。
blocks.en: QCU independence is at the core of CGMP: §211.22 requires the QCU to be organizationally independent of production, with unimpeded authority to release or reject batches. The QCU's authority spans all product types (raw materials, in-process material, finished product), approval of all procedures and specifications, and the power to review all production records. In contract manufacturing, the contract acceptor's (CDMO's) QCU bears independent release responsibility for all contracted batches and cannot shift it onto the client on the grounds that the client has its own QA. The Quality Agreement must clearly define the division of QCU responsibilities.

blocks.zh: 「Right-First-Time」文化超越單純合規： QCU 存在的目的不只是作為最後防線，而是主動介入、預防品質問題。偏差率高但調查快速關閉的設施，往往是 FDA Warning Letter 的目標，反映的是品質文化問題，而非技術問題。
blocks.en: A "Right-First-Time" culture goes beyond mere compliance: The purpose of the QCU is not only to be the last line of defense but to intervene actively and prevent quality problems. Facilities with high deviation rates whose investigations are closed quickly are often the targets of FDA Warning Letters, which reflects a quality culture problem, not a technical one.

blocks.zh: 訓練 ≠ 資格： §211.25 要求的是教育、訓練與經驗的組合。訓練矩陣必須涵蓋初始、持續（「足夠頻率」）、更新、和矯正訓練四種類型。訓練者本身也需要資格文件。§211.25(c) 的人員充足性要求意味著人手嚴重不足本身就是 CGMP 違規。
blocks.en: Training ≠ qualification: §211.25 requires a combination of education, training and experience. The training matrix must cover four types of training: initial, continuing ("sufficient frequency"), change-driven and corrective. Trainers themselves also need qualification documents. The staffing adequacy requirement of §211.25(c) means that a serious shortage of personnel is in itself a CGMP violation.

blocks.zh: §211.28 是無菌製造的底線，不是上限： 法規僅要求「顯見疾病」排除和「如有必要」的防護服。無菌製造設施必須在此基礎上建立更嚴格的著裝資格確認程序（FDA 無菌指引）和潔淨區等級別的詳細著裝規格（EU Annex 1），以滿足全球市場的雙重監管要求。
blocks.en: §211.28 is the floor for sterile manufacturing, not the ceiling: The regulation requires only the exclusion of personnel with "apparent illness" and protective apparel "as necessary." Sterile manufacturing facilities must build on this with stricter gowning qualification procedures (FDA aseptic processing guidance) and detailed gowning specifications for each cleanroom grade (EU Annex 1) to meet the dual regulatory expectations of global markets.

blocks.zh: 顧問記錄是可預防的 483 缺失： §211.34 的顧問資格記錄採功能性認定標準——服務性質決定是否適用，而非合約形式或收費與否。建立顧問資格登錄表（含姓名、地址、資格文件、服務類型）是最簡單的合規措施，但許多公司忽略了「服務範圍隨時間擴大」的記錄更新義務。
blocks.en: Consultant records are a preventable 483 deficiency: The consultant qualification records of §211.34 follow a functional test: the nature of the service decides whether it applies, not the form of the contract or whether payment is made. Setting up a consultant qualification log (with name, address, qualification documents and type of service) is the simplest compliance measure, but many companies overlook the duty to update records as "the scope of service expands over time."

blocks.zh: §211.68 是電子系統進入 CGMP 的法律入口： 校正程序（§211.68(a)）和存取控制/備份（§211.68(b)）是所有藥廠電子系統的基礎義務。在 §211.68(b) 之上，21 CFR Part 11 建立電子記錄/電子簽名框架，CSV/GAMP5 提供系統驗證指引。校正失效的影響評估（out-of-calibration investigation）是高風險的合規盲點，可能觸發批次召回。2013 年後的資料完整性執法浪潮根植於對 §211.68(b) 存取控制要求的長期忽視。
blocks.en: §211.68 is the legal entry point for electronic systems into CGMP: The calibration procedures (§211.68(a)) and access control / backup (§211.68(b)) are foundational obligations for the electronic systems of every drug maker. On top of §211.68(b), 21 CFR Part 11 establishes the electronic records / electronic signatures framework, and CSV / GAMP 5 provides system validation guidance. Impact assessment of calibration failures (out-of-calibration investigation) is a high-risk compliance blind spot and can trigger batch recalls. The wave of data integrity enforcement after 2013 is rooted in the long neglect of the access control requirements of §211.68(b).

blocks.en: Links to Subsequent Sections

blocks.zh: → Section 2（廠房設施與設備）： §211.42 廠房設計要求（潔淨區分級、設備佈局、人員流動路線）是 QCU 必須核准的程序（§211.22(c)）。設施設計決策直接影響本章所建立的人員管控要求。
blocks.en: → Section 2 (Buildings, Facilities and Equipment): The §211.42 facility design requirements (cleanroom classification, equipment layout, personnel flow routes) are procedures the QCU must approve (§211.22(c)). Facility design decisions directly affect the personnel control requirements established in this section.

blocks.zh: → Section 5（實驗室控制與記錄）： QCU 的實驗室設施要求（§211.22(b)）在 §211.160–§211.194 中得到完整展開。§211.68 對電子記錄設備的要求延伸至實驗室儀器（HPLC、pH 計）的稽核追蹤和資料完整性要求。
blocks.en: → Section 5 (Laboratory Controls and Records): The QCU's laboratory facility requirements (§211.22(b)) are developed in full in §211.160-§211.194. The §211.68 requirements for electronic record equipment extend to the audit trail and data integrity requirements of laboratory instruments (HPLC, pH meters).

blocks.zh: → 21 CFR Part 11（本 Hub 獨立文件）： §211.68(b) 的電腦系統要求是 Part 11 適用的前提條件。建議在本章學習後複習 Part 11 文件（Section 1 一般規定、Section 2 封閉/開放系統控制）以建立完整的電子記錄合規框架。
blocks.en: → 21 CFR Part 11 (a separate document in this Hub): The computer system requirements of §211.68(b) are the precondition for Part 11 to apply. After studying this section, review the Part 11 document (Section 1 General Provisions, Section 2 Controls for Closed/Open Systems) to build a complete electronic records compliance framework.
